note: Step 9 research strategy: 20-bar high/low close breakout where current ATR(14) exceeds the prior-20-bar mean ATR (volatility expansion). LONG only (lab Portfolio engine is long-only). Entry next-bar OPEN, exit = standard lab ATR stop (2xATR[t]) / 3R target / 60-bar time exit. Baseline params, no optimization.

signal.expression: close(t) crosses ABOVE max(high, t-20..t-1) [edge] AND ATR14(t) > mean(ATR14, t-20..t-1)
signal.evaluatedAfter: bar close confirmed, t excluded from both references
